'''Gorakus''' was the name of a [[mawvorr]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3640 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gorakus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions or loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
